t: Visualising software architecture with the C4 model - Simon Brown, Agile on the Beach 2019

q.x: These fail my litmus test, which is, "can a third-party look at the diagram and make sense of it without verbal explanation?" For a more formal approach to coherent diagrams and white boarding, I recommend the C4 model.

recs.stt: Beyond Whiteboarding: Creating Expert System Architecture Diagrams
recs.x:
These fail my litmus test, which is, "can a third-party look at the diagram and make sense of it without verbal explanation?" For a more formal approach to coherent diagrams and white boarding, I recommend the C4 model. It's conceptually simple and results in better system documentation than the free form method that's commonly used.
